d: Long, wavy platinum white hair with bangs framing the face. Sharp, narrow pale grey eyes with a stern expression. An adolescent face with a mature, disciplined air and a slender build. A blue military tunic with gold buttons and gold epaulettes, worn under a tattered, oversized black cloak, paired with white trousers and knee-high black leather boots. A silver metallic headpiece with two pointed, horn-like protrusions extending upwards.
